tools.name: ai_visibility_score
tools.description: The same instant AI-visibility snapshot the free /api/diagnose flow returns: a real fetch of the page scored against the 20 ranking elements, honest note text, fail-closed (no fetch = no score, never a guessed number).

tools.name: audit_url
tools.description: Run AnswerBeacon's real 20-element on-page AI-search readiness scan against a public URL or domain (read-only, fails closed -- a page it cannot fetch returns ok=false and no score, never an estimate).

tools.name: get_checkout_link
tools.description: Public pricing URL a human opens to pick and pay for a plan. Read-only: creates no charge.

tools.name: list_pricing
tools.description: Current plans and prices in USD. No account needed.

tools.name: rising_queries
tools.description: Return the honest Google-Trends-derived rising-query content plan for a fleet company (fails soft with available=false when nothing is seeded for that company -- never fabricates a query).

tools.name: schema_check
tools.description: Extract the schema.org / JSON-LD subset of the audit_url scan: detected schema types, JSON-LD parse errors, and the 5 schema-bearing elements (FAQ, Organization, LocalBusiness, Service, Author/Person).
